subject: reasoning
question: In the following question, in each option a pair of figures is given. In each pair the figure towards the left of (:) is related by some logic/rule/relation with the figure on the right of (:). Select the odd figure pair from the given alternatives.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Figure 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ce0e381a51fe086117a5262329405a281dddc99bbbf1940cb061a5f8137e732.png] → Same elements in the both figures i.e. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55c9016a24bcc6eefb8f2c51e0fd3110d2344365030928bc949b1984cef320ed.png] square and triangle.

Figure 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4bfa204684adfe76e027cd79c2c02491641ec3af95fa0b51e75f9fbcc525504.png] → **Different elements in the both figures i.e.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6acabb6182b1fedf1155275e8c10a3e5f60dd7c2ec1bbca08f95ab2c57c474b3.png] ** circle, rectangle and triangle.**

Figure 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ede90006cf36bb8280e0cefd7160240e39429d69b447d7f7a041af35b1a2f1a3.png] → Same elements in the both figures i.e. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bffa78792ce8ca370cc80f8ed6529f00731daf6bd711563fa3f396c0b68d0b5c.png] rectangle and triangle.

Figure 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2687ee594d13f052f6cfab15e408973de052c920e0974c69cf44dbc626e06aff.png] → Same elements in the both figures i.e. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfa6bd4ed664e515e35e176da18aa3b3782b0fc5eeb22d82d5c6aea8326341ff.png] square and triangle.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
